description: Re-sequences the remaining iPermit work to ship the proven deterministic core as a multi-tenant SaaS. Each ticket names the Claude Code agent and skill best suited to the job. Grounded in docs/roadmap.json, the architecture ADRs (docs/architecture/adr-0001..0005), and the open-saas reference (.claude/references/open-saas).
stack_note: iPermit stack is FastAPI + React/TypeScript + Postgres/PostGIS (ADR-0001). open-saas (Wasp/Node/Prisma) is a PATTERN reference for SaaS feature surface only, not a tech match.

agents.Explore: Fast read-only search/locate across the codebase. Use for research and 'where is X' before building.
agents.Plan: Software-architect agent for designing an implementation approach before code.
agents.general-purpose: Multi-step build/refactor work that spans files; the default builder for a ticket.
agents.claude: Catch-all builder when no more specific agent fits.
agents.claude-code-guide: Questions about Claude Code / Agent SDK / Anthropic API usage.

existing.code-review: Review the diff for correctness bugs. Run on every build ticket before commit.
existing.security-review: Security review of pending changes. MANDATORY on auth, tenancy, payments, file-upload, and webhook tickets.
existing.verify: Run the app and observe real behavior to confirm a change works.
existing.run: Launch/drive the app (boot FastAPI + Vite) to see a change working.
existing.claude-api: Build/tune Anthropic SDK features with prompt caching. Use for the constrained-AI epic.

to_author.saas-api: FastAPI REST surface: routers, OpenAPI contract, response envelope {data,meta,advisories,warnings}, RFC-9457 errors, versioning. Ref: ADR-0003; open-saas src/*/operations.ts.
to_author.saas-auth: Identity, password hashing, JWT/session tokens, AuthenticatedIdentity, RBAC, OAuth/SSO path. Ref: ADR-0002; open-saas src/auth.
to_author.saas-multitenancy: tenant_id columns + Postgres RLS (app.current_tenant_id) + app-layer scoping. Ref: ADR-0002.
to_author.saas-frontend: React + TypeScript (Vite) SPA: auth-gated routing, forms, data fetching, generated API client from OpenAPI. Ref: open-saas template/app/src/client + ADR-0001.
to_author.saas-audit: Append-only, hash-chained audit log (prev_hash+hash), INSERT-only role. Ref: ADR-0004.
to_author.saas-payments: Stripe/Lemon Squeezy: plans, checkout, webhooks, subscription state, metering/quotas. Ref: open-saas src/payment.
to_author.saas-file-upload: Validated uploads to object storage (S3). Maps to iPermit shapefile/KMZ intake. Ref: open-saas src/file-upload.
to_author.saas-admin-portal: Internal admin/analyst dashboards and role-gated nav. Ref: open-saas src/admin.
to_author.saas-analytics: Usage metrics and operational dashboards. Ref: open-saas src/analytics.
to_author.saas-email: Transactional email: verification, password reset, notifications. Ref: open-saas emailSender config.
to_author.saas-deploy: IaC, managed Postgres/PostGIS, CI/CD deploy, env/secrets. Ref: ADR-0001; infrastructure/terraform; docs/operations.
to_author.saas-observability: Structured logging, metrics, error tracking, alerting.

epics.title: SaaS spine — thin end-to-end vertical (intake -> permit matrix)
epics.objective: Stand up the multi-tenant web product over the existing deterministic engine: a consultant logs in, creates a tenant-scoped project, submits intake + confirmed GIS, and sees an explainable permit matrix.

tickets.title: Tenancy & project persistence models
tickets.description: Add packages/tenancy-models (Tenant, User, Membership, Project, Evaluation) on the shared ipermit_persistence Base + Alembic migration with Postgres RLS policies.

tickets.title: Auth: AuthenticatedIdentity + email/password + JWT
tickets.description: auth.py with password hashing, JWT issue/verify, get_current_identity dependency, consultant_user role. Defer SSO behind the abstraction.

tickets.title: FastAPI service scaffold + response envelope + errors
tickets.description: services/api/ipermit_api: app.py, settings (BaseSettings), db session dep (sets app.current_tenant_id), envelope {data,meta,advisories,warnings}, RFC-9457 handlers. Record ADR-0006 for the new service boundary.

tickets.title: Permit-matrix contract + builder + evaluate endpoint
tickets.description: permit-matrix.schema.json (+example, register in validate_schemas); matrix.py build_permit_matrix(SimulationResult); endpoints POST /api/v1/projects, POST .../evaluate (wraps ipermit_gis.to_engine_inputs + simulate_project), GET .../matrix. Enforce liability advisories (T07-03).

tickets.title: Minimal audit on evaluation
tickets.description: AuditRecord model + hash-chained insert on each evaluation event (inputs hash, ruleset content_hash, output ids).

tickets.title: Consultant SPA: login + intake -> matrix
tickets.description: apps/web Vite+React+TS: login screen, evaluation screen (intake form + manual jurisdiction/overlay entry), PermitMatrix render (permits, tier, citations, advisories). Generated client from OpenAPI + shared-schemas TS types.

tickets.title: Security review + end-to-end verify of the spine
tickets.description: Security review of auth + tenant isolation; boot API + SPA and walk the flow.

conventions.every_build_ticket: Run the code-review skill on the diff before commit; run the verify/run skills to confirm behavior.
conventions.research_first: Use the Explore agent to locate code and the Plan agent to design before non-trivial tickets.
conventions.security_gated: Run the security-review skill on any ticket touching auth, tenancy, payments, file upload, or webhooks.
conventions.engine_authority: AI (SAAS-08) and all UI must treat the deterministic rules engine as the source of truth; never override it.
